# seller-report
Produces a report from orders.
files.seller_report/report.py:
import requests

ORDERS_URL = "https://orders.test"


def build_report(day):
    response = requests.get(ORDERS_URL + "/orders", params={"day": day}, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["items"]
